The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a workbench introduced with the [[Better Save Soul|Better Save Soul DLC]], that may be built in the [[Souls room]] after you unlock the [[Spiritualism (Tech Tree)|Beginner healer]] technology. The {{PAGENAME}} allows you to store up to 2 souls for later usage, but keep in mind the souls will decay slowly even in this container. Decay rate is around 12% per day . Higher tier containers appear to have slower decay rate , ~ 4% for tier II container (as of version 1.404 , just on one observation ; not precise measurement).

To use one of these containers first, you have to build a frame first [{{PAGENAME}} (Base)], then fill it up by finishing the build with extra materials [{{PAGENAME}} (Finish)]. There are only 3 spots in the [[Souls room]] where this container can be built.

''Note: When a soul stays in the container for too long, it will eventually die and leave a [[Sin Shard]] behind.''
